# Pull Request

## Description

Describe the scenario and the change.

## Validation

- [ ] The sample builds and runs using its documented steps.
- [ ] The README explains prerequisites, setup, deployment, usage, limitations, and support status.
- [ ] The README ends with the sample-specific `m365-visitor-stats` image tracker using the sample folder name.
- [ ] `assets/sample.json` is complete and matches the README.
- [ ] At least one local image is referenced in `thumbnails`; the first image by ascending `order` is suitable for the catalog.
- [ ] Every referenced image has meaningful alt text and contains no sensitive or personal information.
- [ ] Dates, author attribution, source URL, and download URL are current.
- [ ] No generated packages, secrets, or tenant-specific values are included.
